summary: Comprehensive regression run completed for requested batch. Backend: 30/30 pytest passing across org registration, rating flows, and new push notification regressions (including queue retry/cleanup with MOCKED provider only in unit tests). Frontend: responsive and integration checks executed via Playwright on public URL with desktop/mobile screenshots; core org registration and push settings UI reachable, but key integration/auth hardening issues remain.

critical.issue: Unauthenticated request returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of 401/403.
Password hashing is SHA-256 (server.py hash_password) instead of bcrypt ($2b$), with no brute-force lockout after repeated failed attempts.

minor.issue: No application auth cookie (httpOnly session cookie) is set by backend login flow; auth is bearer-token only.
seed admin path only enforces is_admin flag; does not update existing admin password when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.

ui_bugs.issue: LFG -> Paid mode toggle does not restore previous payout value (observed restored value: 0).

integration_issues.issue: Console repeatedly shows 500 on /api/push/inbox when app bootstraps unauthenticated state before demo token is established.
Not fully verifiable in headless environment; browser reported 'Blocked in browser settings' path. Service worker/provider live delivery cannot be claimed E2E from this run.

issues: Known smoke issue acknowledged: animated ticker descendants can extend right while clipped (alert-ticker-content / repeated all-clear rows).
Targeted fix suggestion: constrain animated content width to container, avoid duplicate all-clear node expansion, keep animation transform inside overflow-hidden wrapper.

action_items: Fix /api/push/inbox auth guard to return 401/403 for missing/invalid bearer token (not 500).
Migrate password hashing to bcrypt ($2b$) and add brute-force lockout/rate-limit policy for login.
Implement seed-admin password reconciliation when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
Fix payout restoration regression when toggling LFG back to Paid in create modal.
Validate and fix ticker animated overflow behavior noted by smoke while preserving alert animations.
After fixes, rerun frontend push tests in headed/real-browser permission-enabled environment for closed-tab delivery verification.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5333+ lines (well beyond maintainability threshold); split auth, push, org-admin, contracts, and signals routers into separate modules.
Settings.jsx is 1200+ lines and should be split similarly to Contracts/Organizations refactor pattern.
Auth uses unsalted SHA-256; this is a security weakness and fails expected modern auth baseline.
CORS middleware defaults to '*' in code while allow_credentials=True; risky/misconfigured pattern for credentialed requests.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (core routes and most flows pass; key issues listed)
